responsibility: Declares the generated pass-C parser entry point. Its `CompilationUnit` routine runs the constant-resolution parse that determines the types and structure of designator and aggregate constants before the executable pass uses them.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface file for the pass-C parser, exporting only CompilationUnit; unlike PCBuild.bnf, it does not contain the grammar or semantic actions for constant-resolution reparsing.
